eventMetadata.context_description: Tennessee's slim 51.5% implied probability edge over Virginia stems from their superior offensive firepower, led by All-SEC guard Zakai Zeigler averaging 14 points amid a five-game win streak, contrasting Virginia's elite pack-line defense that stifles opponents to under 60 points per game. Trader consensus highlights competitive balance through Tennessee's turnover-prone backcourt vulnerable to Virginia's length and rebounding edge, plus the Cavaliers' 8-2 road record masking potential rust from a lighter non-conference slate. Momentum could shift with Thursday's official injury reports—Zeigler's questionable ankle or Virginia forward Ryan Dunn's status—or early scouting from beat reporters on lineup tweaks, as rest advantages and neutral-site familiarity keep odds fluid in this defensive grind.
